The most notable transaction occurred on 2024-11-10 at time slot 3, where KRW 49,000,000 was transferred via mobile phone (media_type 4) using an inter‑bank auto transfer (fund_type 4) to account 551023. The model predicts a 90% probability that this transaction is fraudulent. The shortest‑path analysis shows a direct fund flow from 29501 → 551023 → 773245 → 99801, moving KRW 145,000,000, indicating possible layering of funds toward the target account 99801.
